https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated environments for software development, testing, and deployment, enabling teams to streamline workflows and reduce turnaround times for application delivery.
business_requirements: Users must be able to quickly create isolated, automated environments for software development and testing.
Users must have the ability to manage and monitor active environments, including starting, stopping, and deleting them as needed.
The system must allow integration with popular version control platforms (e.g., GitHub) to pull code repositories directly into environments.
Users must be able to configure environment specifications, such as resource allocation and runtime settings, prior to deployment.
The platform must support role-based access control to ensure team members have appropriate permissions for managing environments.
Users must have access to real-time environment utilization metrics and logs for troubleshooting and optimization purposes.
The system must offer templates or preconfigured environments for common use cases to accelerate the setup process.
